source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 4 June 1955, p. 4 ("Notice of result of elections: Magherafelt Rural District Council, 1955 (Returning Officer's notice, signed W. J. M'Kinney)"); Derry Journal, 18 May 1955, p. 2 ("Magherafelt Rural Council: no nominations for Draperstown and Brackaghslievegallion")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: deemed re-elected: no nomination was received for Draperstown (Derry Journal 18 May 1955 p2: 'There were no nominations received for Draperstown and Brackaghslievegallion divisions. The outgoing members are Mr. C. Campbell and Mr. G. V. Holmes respectively'); the Returning Officer's notice (Mid-Ulster Mail 4 Jun 1955 p4, page image read) enters 'Campbell, Chas.' (Gortnaskea, Draperstown) in column 7, 'Names of retiring Councillors deemed to be re-elected'.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. The only contest was in Ballyronan (Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1955, p. 7; Derry Journal, 3 June 1955, p. 1). The other twenty-five divisions added from the Returning Officer's notice of the result (Mid-Ulster Mail, 4 June 1955, p. 4; its heading misprints 'Election of County Councillors'): twenty-three returned without a poll, and in Brackaghslievegallion and Draperstown, where no one was nominated, the retiring members George Holmes and Charles Campbell were deemed re-elected (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
